Class PlaceTotemPhase

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.phase.PlaceTotemPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhase
public class PlaceTotemPhase extends Object implements GamePhase
Represents the phase where players place their totems on the offer track.

During this state, players select an available slot on the offer track to determine their playing order for the subsequent phase, consisting in picking up cards. The phase tracks which players have already acted and automatically transitions the game to the PlayerOfferPhase once everyone has placed their totem.

    • PlaceTotemPhase

      public PlaceTotemPhase(Set<Player> playersPlaced)
      Reconstructs the phase from a saved state.

      This constructor is utilized exclusively by GamePhase.fromSnapshot(PhaseSnapshot, List, int) during the server recovery process to restore the exact state of players who had already placed their totems before the crash.

      Parameters:
      playersPlaced - the set of players who have already completed their turn in this phase

  • Method Details

    • placeTotem

      public List<GameDelta> placeTotem(Game game, Player player, char position)
      Handles the placement of a player's totem on the board.

      The method validates that the player hasn't already acted. If valid, the board registers the placement. If this action concludes the phase (i.e., all players have placed their totems), the state automatically shifts to the PlayerOfferPhase.

      Specified by:
      placeTotem in interface GamePhase
      Parameters:
      game - the main game instance
      player - the player placing the totem
      position - the character identifier of the chosen track slot
      Returns:
      a list of GameDelta to be broadcasted to clients to update their UI
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the player attempts to place a totem more than once
